notes: Two sets. offline-fixtures: scripted transport/writer controls; target/labelTags/labelSummary are what the scripted provider returns, failure names an injected fault, mutable lists owner-approved fields (default all). semantic-benchmark: authored type/tags/summary goldens with facts and prohibited claims; type 'unclear' means route to review with no write. files is the materialized input tree; expectedChangedFiles lists, per enrichment mode, only the files whose exact bytes should change (every other file must stay byte-identical).

types.note: General source, reference, inventory, proposal or uncertainty. An unapproved proposal is not a ruling. This is the ordinary inbox type.
types.entry: Custom inbox counterpart of note; same semantic definition, selected only when this taxonomy uses entry as its inbox.
types.logbook: A dated or ordered first-person record of completed travel or work. A plan, theory, prediction or quoted old journal alone does not qualify.
types.ruling: An explicitly adopted decision, including a binding conditional decision. Preserve conditions and distinguish proposals or disputed recollections from adoption.

tags.navigation: Travel routes, movements or concrete travel plans; not the incidental mention of a voyage in an unrelated inventory.
tags.council: A formal meeting, its proposed choices or adopted decisions. Does not mean every speaker agreed or a proposal was approved.
tags.stewardship: Care, custody, maintenance or accounting of stores, tools, land or records.

summaryRubric.summary: Accept any concise source-supported paraphrase retaining the case's salient facts, negation, uncertainty, actor and conditions. Do not require the authored exact sentence. Unsupported completion, approval, dates or instructions are factual errors. Missing summaries in classification-only are a task-output tradeoff, never free equivalent quality.
summaryRubric.classification: Score raw type and each controlled tag against independently reviewed source meanings separately from effective protected owner fields. Unclear/unapproved type routes to configured inbox/review without completed write; custom inbox is not hardcoded note. Abstention and paired confidence/selected-P coverage are reported separately.
